title: Champagne news-letters to Nevers 1590-91 and Laurière to Nevers 1593, BnF fr. 3623 and fr. 3625 (catalogue item 30)

plaintext.source: key slip f. 36r bound with the copy

transcription.notes: Copy in clear with code numbers for nine persons/places only; not tokenised.

plaintext.source: a few letters glossed over figures in nos. 25 and 60

One group of mixed figures and signs.

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 3625 no. 55, f. 66r (Gallica btv1b52511322v canvas 143)

plaintext.source: one gloss on the leaf ('come'); sibling no. 10 (f. 10r) carries an interlinear decipherment of the same code

system.summary: No. 23: a small name code with its key bound in; nos. 24/25/60: a two-digit homophonic alphabet in alphabetical order with a few code numbers.
system.sibling_key: none; Tomokiyo's Nevers key no. 46 checked and does not fit; siblings nos. 26/27 in another key
system.notes: No. 55 (Lauriere, f. 66r) is a mixed syllabic figure-and-sign code; sibling no. 10 has an interlinear decipherment.

prior_solution.where: no. 23 key slip bound with the letter (f. 36r); interlinear glosses in no. 25 and no. 60

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code and posed the catalogue task via a parent agent. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Tomokiyo's nevers.htm and GL.htm, DECODE list for fr. 3623/3625; no prior reading; DECODE gives folios.
Gallica thumbnails of both volumes; contact sheets; full-resolution pages of ff. 35-41, 88, 111 (fr. 3623) and ff. 10, 16 (fr. 3625).
No. 23: key slip on f. 36r transcribed; every code number in the letter resolves.
Tomokiyo's no. 46 (nevers1593/key46.txt) tried on no. 24's figures: values do not fit.
Twelve two-digit runs of nos. 24, 25, 60 transcribed with the faint interlinear letters.
Interlinear glosses (Ludovic, union, a, n) give anchors; the values rise with the alphabet.
Alphabetical slots fill the table: la ligue, de la defiance du [17], de Chazeron, service read; two no. 24 runs stay open.
Search for fr. 3625 no. 55 across canvases 13-64 and 81-200: not found; no. 10 found at f. 10r with interlinear decipherment.
OAI item list of fr. 3625 matched to folios (no. 49 = f. 61, dated 3 not 9 July); no. 55 found at f. 66r, canvas 143; canvases 65-80 and 201-270 looked over.
No. 55 transcribed (8 runs, 86 groups); first three runs of no. 10 aligned with their interlinear decipherment.
Groups shared with no. 10's glossed runs read in no. 55: que le Roy soit encores, la volonte du pape, aussitost; about 15 of 86 groups.

outcome.notes: No. 23 read in full from its key; nos. 24/25/60 about three quarters of runs read; no. 55 read in fragments from no. 10's glosses; no. 78 open.
